load_latest_quality_results: SELECT control_id, check_name, status, failed_rows, severity, executed_at FROM quality_check_results ORDER BY control_id
load_reconciliation_summary: SELECT reconciliation_name, source_count, target_count, count_delta, source_total, target_total, amount_delta, executed_at FROM reconciliation_results ORDER BY executed_at DESC LIMIT 20
load_transaction_volume: SELECT booking_date, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count, ROUND(SUM(amount_chf), 2) AS total_amount_chf FROM transactions GROUP BY booking_date ORDER BY booking_date
load_status_summary: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count, ROUND(SUM(amount_chf), 2) AS total_amount_chf FROM transactions GROUP BY status ORDER BY status
load_channel_summary: SELECT channel, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count, ROUND(AVG(risk_score), 4) AS avg_risk_score FROM transactions GROUP BY channel ORDER BY transaction_count DESC
load_suspicious_transactions: SELECT transaction_id, account_id, event_timestamp, amount_chf, channel, country, risk_score, status, is_suspicious FROM transactions WHERE is_suspicious ORDER BY risk_score DESC, event_timestamp DESC LIMIT 7
load_prediction_summary: SELECT priority_band, transaction_count, avg_score, total_amount_chf, labelled_suspicious, last_scored_at FROM gold.vw_prediction_summary ORDER BY CASE priority_band WHEN 'high' THEN 1 WHEN 'medium' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END
load_top_predictions: SELECT p.transaction_id, p.suspicion_score, p.priority_band, f.amount_chf, f.channel, f.merchant_category, f.booking_hour, f.is_cross_border, f.is_suspicious AS labelled, p.model_version FROM gold.predictions p JOIN gold.fact_transactions f USING (transaction_id) ORDER BY p.suspicion_score DESC LIMIT 9
load_risk_heatmap: SELECT booking_hour, channel, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN is_suspicious THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) * 100, 1) AS suspicion_rate_pct FROM gold.fact_transactions WHERE NOT is_demo_row GROUP BY booking_hour, channel HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 ORDER BY booking_hour, channel
load_volume_trend: WITH daily AS ( SELECT date_key, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count, ROUND(SUM(amount_chf), 2) AS total_amount_chf FROM gold.fact_transactions WHERE NOT is_demo_row GROUP BY date_key ) SELECT date_key, transaction_count, total_amount_chf, ROUND(AVG(transaction_count) OVER ( ORDER BY date_key ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ), 1) AS rolling_7d_avg, transaction_count - LAG(transaction_count) OVER (ORDER BY date_key) AS change_vs_previous_day FROM daily ORDER BY date_key
load_segment_cohorts: SELECT a.customer_segment, f.merchant_category, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count, ROUND(SUM(f.amount_chf), 2) AS total_amount_chf, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN f.is_suspicious THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) * 100, 1) AS suspicion_rate_pct, ROUND(AVG(f.amount_chf), 2) AS avg_amount_chf FROM gold.fact_transactions f JOIN gold.dim_account a ON a.account_id = f.account_id WHERE NOT f.is_demo_row GROUP BY a.customer_segment, f.merchant_category HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY suspicion_rate_pct DESC
load_control_trend: SELECT date_key, control_id, SUM(is_pass) AS passes, SUM(is_fail) AS failures, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(is_pass) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS pass_rate_pct FROM gold.fact_quality_results GROUP BY date_key, control_id ORDER BY date_key, control_id
